---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

shortened_seasons <- c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarize(
		total_home_runs = sum(HR),
		total_team_games = sum(G),
		.groups = "drop"
	) |>
	mutate(
		home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games,
		season_type = if_else(
			yearID %in% shortened_seasons,
			"Shortened season",
			"Regular season"
		)
	)

hr_by_season |>
	filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |>
	arrange(yearID) |>
	print()
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
	geom_line(color = "gray70") +
	geom_point(aes(color = season_type), size = 2) +
	scale_color_manual(
		values = c("Regular season" = "gray30", "Shortened season" = "#d95f02")
	) +
	labs(
		title = "Home runs per team-game by season",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Home runs per team-game",
		color = "Season type",
		caption = "Source: Lahman database"
	)
```
